authorization: User explicitly requested both methods, sequential execution, repository delivery; supplementary K calibration and residual oracle ladder included.
class_condition: unconditional VAR class1000; no true class supplied to RX
visual_interface: Existing frozen encoder, original ten-scale VQ, VAR-d16 and selected Dc; original coordinates F shape32x16x16
generation: Deterministic argmax, no CFG, original FP32 deterministic numerical protocol; not called posterior sampling

method1.partial_counts: floor(next-scale length times .25,.5,.75), and maximum legal K; deduplicate; K=0 whole always available; exclude K>=next-scale length
method1.header: 68 QPSK symbols; m3bits + K7bits + order2bits, CRC16, tail6, original FEC/rate matching
method1.body: K0 single prefix packet; K>0 separate prefix and partial CRC16+tail6 packets. Oracle partial adds explicit next-scale-length binary mask.
method1.allocation: Public proportional information+CRC+tail allocation clamped to each packet rate cap; derived from received header
method1.failure: Header invalid: RGB.5 erasure. Prefix CRC failure: keep unverified hard prefix, discard all partial data in every scheme. Partial CRC failure: discard partial and complete from prefix. No feedback or receiver-only order change.
method1.entropy: Full4096-way probabilities conditioned only on prefix, deterministic quantized entropy descending and index ascending ties. Identical pinned implementation at both endpoints.
method1.random: Deterministic prefix-derived per-position SHA256 permutation with public seed; never untransmitted image identity
method1.oracle: TX prioritizes positions where greedy next-scale prediction is wrong, explicit paid mask; diagnostic reference, not mathematically optimal image-quality bound
method1.selection_screen: First200 original calibration sources, seed4101, all legal candidates. Each N/PHY/SNR/order retains top2 feasible candidates and best whole K0 reference.
method1.selection_final: All1000 original calibration sources and all3 seeds on frozen shortlist; independently select each N/PHY/SNR/order; K0 admissible. No development access before policies frozen.
method1.selection_objective: Original failure-rate reference and PSNR>=reference-.25dB constraint, then minimum mean Dc LPIPS; fixed lexical tie break. DINO reported, not selected.
method1.development: Independent selected policies plus raster/random/oracle at entropy policy's same m,K where legal; zero-noise source rate curves separately labelled, no interpolation as measured points
method1.primary_order_contrast: entropy vs both raster and random at identical m,K,N,PHY and shared new-study noise; QPSK exact E2N,16QAM actual E differences reported
method1.legacy_reference: Frozen N512/N1024 U policy and P rows with exact data/model identity, no historical reruns except small parity qualification; extended whole m8 tested where legal

method2.residual: area_g(F - exact cumulative true m4 prefix), shape32xgxg at TX; clean residual is permitted ONLY as explicitly labelled oracle observation
method2.pca: One shared across-channel PCA basis fitted on1000 calibration m4 residuals at16x16 locations; same basis at every spatial position and grid; measurements uncentered, no spatial mixing or neural training
ladder: same reduced measurements with target SNR noise
actual paid digital/analog link only if calibration gate passes
method2.feasibility: header68 + digital m4 CRC/tail protected at rate<=.9 + paid float32 gain control32 + g*g*c/2 measurement complex uses +1 paid energy padding complex; remaining symbols protect digital prefix; infeasible profiles excluded
controls: direct residual correction without guided token generation
method2.likelihood_scope: Gaussian working/composite likelihood with calibrated unobserved residual covariance; exact forward projected contribution retains phi/bicubic coupling and bias-difference handling; not claimed exact independent posterior
method2.real_link_gate: At least one budget-feasible reduced/noisy projection at7dB: calibrated guided vs unguided PSNR>=+.5dB and LPIPS<=-.02 with paired95% intervals excluding0, and DINO loss<=.01. Gate uses only calibration. Controls and P compared separately; passing gate alone does not prove VAR-specific gain.
method2.failed_gate: Complete and publish oracle ladder, record actual link SKIPPED_GATE_NOT_MET; do not grow grid or train
method2.gain_protocol: Quantized downward positive float32 gain transmitted as32 payload bits withCRC16+tail6 over32QPSKuses; one extra paid analog symbol fills energy deficit and RX ignores it. Failed gain/prefixCRC discards analog. QPSK full frame E2N;16QAM digital actualE retained.
method2.calibration_policy: Fit PCA/structural mean and scalar variance on1000cal; first200cal at7dB three noises selects VAR and static lambda independently from[.25,.5,1,2]; all1000cal three noises validates gate for selected VAR at feasible projected profiles; all choices frozen before development. Actual-link projection chosen from passed candidates on first200cal perN/PHY/SNR.
method2.actual_header: 68QPSK symbols with12-bit code (m4<<3)|projection_index, CRC16/tail6; no true class; received code must match frozen public projection
method2.received_gain_validation: Finite positive received gain plus finite FP32-representable recovered observation and strictly positive finite FP32-representable variance; otherwise discard analog and record numeric failure without consulting TX truth

statistics.unit: source image; mean noise within source
statistics.intervals: paired95% percentile descriptive intervals on repeatedly reused development; no training-seed uncertainty

deliverables: per-frame paid resource and failure ledger
stop: After two authorized methods and conditional actual-link branch are reported and pushed; preserve all prior models/results; no other queues or training
